messages:
Sam: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — opening a short Q&A thread for anything we didn't get to about headcount reallocations, role transitions, and hiring cadence. I'll answer inline. Ask away!
Isabel: Thanks Sam. Quick question — are we instituting any hiring freezes for teams (eg eng-runtime)?
Sam: Not a blanket freeze. We're pausing new requisitions for non-customer-facing IC roles for ~6 weeks to re-evaluate priorities. Customer-facing, infra, and SRE hiring continues. Recruiters will get details.
Kai: @Sam can we get a very rough breakdown by team (even ballpark numbers)?
Sam: High level snapshot (work in progress):
```
product: +50 FTE (12mo)
infra: +30
eng-runtime: +10
ml-research: +8
```
These are net new hires, not including internal transfers. I'll attach a one-page snapshot to the handbook. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maria: Clarify — those are net new hires or include transfers/backfills?
Sam: Net new hires. Expect ~15 internal transfers as part of team reorgs (backfills handled separately).
Nadia: What happens to candidates already in the loop for paused reqs — are we pausing interviews/offers?
Isabel: Hiring pipeline remains active overall. For reqs we paused, recruiters will review current candidates case-by-case and notify them this week. If you're interviewing someone, TA will follow up. @Kai can coordinate prioritization with your hiring managers.
Kai: Thanks — we'll prioritize mission-critical roles and green-offer candidates.
DevRel Bot: note: Headcount doc updated at /handbook/headcount/2026-03-snapshot (view-only).
Sam: Timeline Q: team mapping and manager assignments?
Isabel: Aim to finalize team maps and manager pairings in ~3 weeks. Affected managers will receive 1:1s this week. Org chart will be posted to Confluence and linked in the handbook snapshot.
Maria: Any impact on promotion cycles or comp budgeting?
Sam: Promotion cycles are unchanged. We are rebalancing hiring budgets across teams but comp bands remain the same. Compensation will publish updated guidance by EOD Friday.
Nadia: How should folks apply for transfers if they're interested?
Isabel: Fill the internal mobility form linked in the handbook snapshot and cc your current manager. We'll run rolling reviews and prioritize based on business need and role fit.
Kai: One ask — can we get a TL;DR FAQ for ICs (one-pager)?
Sam: Yes — I'll publish a 1-page FAQ in #announcements and attach it to the handbook doc.
Maria: Appreciate the clarity :heart:
Sam: Thanks all. If you have sensitive questions DM me or your manager. We'll keep updates coming in this thread and the handbook snapshot.
